name.description: User mixed collection name. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; an existing same-name user collection is reused. No namespace argument. Use returned collection.id for add-to-collection.
Editable material name; never accepted for history or artist_favorite.

group.description: Group name for tag/combo/note/style_preset/reference_preset only. Never history; mixed collections use add-to-collection.

notes.description: Note prose for tag/combo/note/study. Keep user feedback and AI observations attributed; do not add invented fields.

groupId.description: History only: existing history-group raw ID from collections; empty string clears that history group. Never a user collection name or encoded user collectionId.

patch.description: Allowed update fields by kind: history: groupId only (existing history-group raw ID; never name or group); tag/combo/note: name, group, notes; study: name, notes; style_preset: name, group, prompt; positive_preset: name, prompt; prompt_chunk: name, content, updatedAt; reference_preset: name, group, strength, infoExtracted, preciseType, fidelity, informationExtracted; artist_favorite: none. Note prose belongs in notes; do not invent fields. To collect history and notes together, create-collection then add-to-collection with its returned collectionId, not update.

asset_library.description: AI list is summary-only (default 10, max 20, 12 KiB UTF-8 JSON). Explicit image reads one selected history original by kind/id/exact revision/registered assetId; variant defaults to thumbnail (max 384), original must be explicit. Native attachment only, no workspace, paths, batch, exports or automatic reads. Read detail:summary|full; history defaults to summary, other kinds to full. Summaries are not recipes or verified images. Explicit full is untruncated and may be large. Create a mixed user collection with {action:"create-collection",name}; reuse its returned collection.id for explicit versioned membership changes. System namespaces are not public; mutate delete with a user collectionId moves that collection (not its items) to Recently Deleted. Note prose belongs in notes; do not invent fields. To collect history and notes together, create-collection then add-to-collection with its returned collectionId, not update.
